anomalies.observed: R6 is shown as a 10 MΩ pull-up on the DISP_SCL net.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires R6 to be 10 kΩ on DISP_SCL.

evidence.quote: DISP_SCL: U2 pin 34 (`PB13`) — R6 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pin 18 (`D0`)

anomalies.impact: A 10 MΩ pull-up is about 1000× too weak for the intended 10 kΩ I2C pull-up, so DISP_SCL will have excessive rise time and the OLED I2C bus may be slow or fail to communicate.
